title: Fix Code Breachs in Compose Cs and Grasshopper Cs
description: Fix all code breachs in compose/net/Compose/Compose.cs (84 breachs) and compose/gh/Compose.Grasshopper/Compose.Grasshopper.cs (114 breachs) by adding summary comments after section markers and before definitions, plus spec comments with RFC2119 keywords on classes, structs, and methods.
summary: Fixed all code breachs in compose/net/Compose/Compose.cs (47→0) and compose/gh/Compose.Grasshopper/Compose.Grasshopper.cs (85→0). Added Imports/Namespace section wrappers for orphan definitions, RFC2119-keyword section summaries for 70 sections, and definition summary+spec comments for 29 class definitions across both files.
